title: Speaking Multiple Languages Affects the Moral Bias of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the MORALDIRECTION framework (using PCA on sentence embeddings of action verbs in question templates) to extract a moral subspace, and evaluating models on the translated Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) to measure their sense of right and wrong.

Comparing moral direction scores across five languages (Arabic, Czech, German, English, Chinese) using translated templates and parallel subtitle corpora to determine if multilingual models reflect distinct cultural norms or impose a Western-centric worldview.
